aiFill.title: Let AI fill it in
aiFill.sub: Describe the idea in your own words and get the form filled, or let your own AI agent build the rikma.
aiFill.label: Tell us about the rikma: the idea, who it is for, what it needs to start
aiFill.placeholder: For example: a neighbourhood café that doubles as a workspace. I bring the place, we need a barista and a designer, and we want to open mornings first...
aiFill.more: {{count}} more characters and you can start
aiFill.planNote: AI fills in the name, the descriptions (including a rich internal one) and the values, and drafts missions and resources for you to approve after creating.
aiFill.errLimit: You have reached the draft limit for now. Try again later, or use your own agent.
aiFill.errAuth: You need to be signed in to draft a rikma.
aiFill.errGeneric: We could not draft it this time. Try wording it a little differently, or fill the form by hand.
aiFill.agentBody: Connect Claude or another agent to 1lev1 in a few clicks. It understands the idea in depth, prepares this form filled in, and then opens missions, runs timers and shows what is waiting for approval.
aiFill.agentExample: "I have an idea for a neighbourhood café that doubles as a workspace. Make me a rikma with the first missions."
